note: Wave B1 (topic 0.23 STRESS_12, option B; the author asked to research every option). A fixed point (asymptotic safety) can predict only irrelevant, dimensionless couplings; Lambda_eff, m_psi^2, m_chi^2 and g_c are relevant and stay free, so option B cannot touch the 1.8e-60 hierarchy. Scale symmetry (S1) and a fixed point are complementary (dilaton quantum gravity, Wetterich 2013, proposed, not established). The one-loop flow (standard formulas from the literature, not rederived here) shows lambda_psi = 0 is stable but the card's chi has no |chi|^2 R term while beta_xi_chi(0) = -lambda_chi/(12 pi^2): the card is not closed under renormalization and generates one of the Higgs-dilaton terms. Not UET-distinct.
